title: limenet baseline policy
description: Policy values shared verbatim by the PHP (limenet/laravel-baseline) and JS (@limenet-ch/baseline) runners. Anything that is a value rather than logic belongs here, so a floor is bumped in one place.

checkMatch.description: Substring identifying an existing check entry in post-update-cmd, with or without --fix.

periodicMatch.description: Substring identifying the periodic command, which must not run on every composer update.

periodicCommand.description: What an expired periodic check tells the developer to run.

ciJobTemplates.description: A single shared template the job must extend, or a list of templates any one of which is accepted.

minMajor.description: Lowest permitted Node major. Declarations below it are bumped to it; newer lines are left alone.

constraint.description: The engines.npm constraint written when none is present or the present one is too low.

minReleaseAgeDays.description: Install-time cooldown in days: npm skips versions younger than this.

minReleaseAgeExclude.description: Packages .npmrc must exempt from the cooldown via min-release-age-exclude[]. js only: it is the npm runner itself, which a Laravel project never installs, and a baseline fix should not wait a week to reach its consumers.

engineStrict.description: Whether .npmrc must set engine-strict, making the engines requirement enforced rather than advisory.

biome.description: Biome's config file and the $schema it must point at. The local path under node_modules always matches the installed Biome, so the file does not need editing on every Biome update — a versioned remote URL does.

configFile.description: Project-relative path of Biome's config file. Checked only when it exists; the baseline does not require a project to use Biome.

schema.description: The value $schema must hold, resolved from node_modules rather than pinned to a released version.

template.description: Filename under policy/templates/ holding the canonical .editorconfig body.

requiredProperties.description: Substrings that must appear in an existing .editorconfig for it to count as complete.

forbidden.description: Project-relative path => reason it must not exist. Rendered as "Remove {path} — {reason}".

shared.description: permissions.allow entries that apply to every project type.

composer.description: permissions.allow entries for every composer project under DDEV (laravel, php and wordpress profiles).

laravel.description: permissions.allow entries that only make sense in a Laravel project (artisan).

shared.description: permissions.deny entries that apply to every project type. Dynamic per-environment entries are derived at runtime, not listed here.

laravel.description: permissions.ask entries for the artisan commands that destroy database contents. Laravel only. These prompt rather than deny, so the developer keeps an approval path.

nodeVersionVariable.description: The CI variable that pins the Node version. Setting it lets the shared template resolve the version, which is what keeps CI and local in step now that DDEV's nodejs_version: auto is not in play.

requiredJobs.description: GitLab CI job name => the shared template it must extend, or a list of templates any one of which is accepted, per profile. The js set omits the php job; php and wordpress omit the test job.

required.description: Substrings the project's ci-lint script must contain — a composer script for every composer profile, an npm script for js.

linters.description: Linter package => the command ci-lint must run when that package is installed. At least one must be installed.

typeChecker.description: The command ci-lint must run once the project contains a file with one of these extensions, outside node_modules and dot-directories. A plain JS project has nothing for it to check.

baselineCommand.description: How the baseline runner invokes itself from a project. The php runner hooks composer's post-update-cmd instead, which npm has no equivalent of.

trivy.description: Trivy's canonical setup. The template under policy/templates/ is both what a fix writes into an empty project and the requirement set itself: every scalar leaf must be equal in the project's file, every list leaf must be contained in it, and unlisted keys are the project's own business.

template.description: Filename under policy/templates/ holding the canonical trivy.yaml body.

configFile.description: Project-relative path of Trivy's config file.

ignoreFile.description: Project-relative path of the ignore file, which must exist even when empty.

gitignoreEntry.description: The cache directory, as it must appear in .gitignore.

forbiddenKeys.description: Top-level keys that must NOT be set, leaving Trivy's own default behaviour in place.

baseline.description: The two runners' own package names, so each can recognise the other's presence in a project, and how a composer project invokes the PHP runner.

runner.description: Per PHP runner: laravel is the artisan command, standalone is vendor/bin/baseline (the php and wordpress profiles).

required.description: npm scripts every project must define.

themeVersionHook.description: The release-it after:bump hook releaseItBumpsWordpressThemeVersion adds: rewrites the Version: header of style.css to the version release-it just bumped to. release-it interpolates ${version} before the shell runs, so the script sits in single quotes to keep the shell off $1.

phpFileCoverage.description: What phpstanCoversAllPhpFiles and rectorCoversAllPhpFiles (php and wordpress profiles) treat as the project's PHP files. Dot-directories and git-ignored files are never counted.

ignoredDirectories.description: Directory names skipped at any depth, e.g. dependencies installed into the project.

exempt.description: Project-relative files that need not be analysed, e.g. the Rector config itself.
